component.name: Helpix
component.summary: Fix your Linux PC with the AI you already use
Risolvi i problemi del PC Linux con l'IA che usi già

description.p: Helpix is an open source troubleshooting assistant for Linux. It opens ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or DeepSeek with your own account, pastes screenshots straight into the chat, runs the commands the AI suggests with one click and brings the output back to the conversation.

Helpix è un assistente open source per risolvere i problemi di Linux. Apre ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot o DeepSeek con il tuo account, incolla gli screenshot direttamente nella chat, esegue con un clic i comandi che l'IA propone e riporta l'output nella conversazione.

ul.li: Screenshots and quick diagnostics pasted into the chat
Commands run with a warning for the risky ones; administrator password asked by the system
Continue a task with another AI, or with Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI in a real terminal
Quick window with a global shortcut, privacy shield, optional lock and encrypted export
Screenshot e diagnosi rapida incollati nella chat
Comandi eseguiti con avviso per quelli rischiosi; la password di amministratore la chiede il sistema
Continua un task con un'altra IA, o con Claude Code, Codex o Gemini CLI in un terminale vero
Finestra rapida con scorciatoia globale, scudo privacy, blocco ed export cifrato facoltativi

screenshot.caption: Helpix with the chat and the screenshot and command tools

description.p: The RPM package installs on Fedora again: it requires glibc by version instead of a versioned symbol.
The Debian/Ubuntu package no longer pulls in Firefox; system dependencies fixed for Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and ARM.
Packages for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, RHEL and openSUSE with signed repositories: updates arrive with apt, dnf and zypper.
First public release under the GPL-3.0-or-later license.
